import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import run

def mk(data, expect=None, name='a'):
    c=[{"name":name,"frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],
        "expect":expect or {"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}]
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":c,"events":[],
            "channels":[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":name,"data":data}]}]}

def probe(label, data, expect=None):
    out = run(mk(data, expect))
    if 'error' in out:
        print('%-44s -> INPUT ERROR' % label); return
    ch = out['channels'][0]
    reqs = ch['requests']
    info = []
    for r in reqs:
        info.append((r['start'], r['end'], r['framing'], r['host_count'], r['body']['n'], r['trailers']['n'], r['flags']))
    print('%-44s -> err=%s reqs=%s committed=%s' % (label, ch['error'], info, ch['committed']))
